ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
calibration_summary: Calibration in ISO 14443 is split between PCD-side analog calibration (antenna tuning, transmit / receive level setting, EMC compliance) and PCD-side timing calibration (carrier frequency tolerance, FDT measurement) — the PICC itself is intentionally not calibrated by the PCD; it self-trims internally at wafer probe. ISO 10373-6 defines the normative compliance test method using a reference Calibration Coil Antenna and a sense coil to measure PCD field strength + modulation envelope + load-modulation amplitude.

pcd_antenna_tuning.purpose: Tune the PCD antenna's resonant LC tank to 13.56 MHz under the actual PCB stack-up and enclosure.
procedure: 1. Probe the antenna with a network analyzer; measure S11 around 13.56 MHz.
2. Adjust matching network capacitors (typical CL-shunt + Ct-tank) to minimise S11 (return loss) at 13.56 MHz; achieve VSWR ≤ 1.5:1.
3. Q-factor target: PCD Q ≈ 30..40 (lower than PICC Q to keep envelope rise/fall times within 0.5 μs for Type A 106 kbps).
4. Verify Hmin = 1.5 A/m is achieved at the maximum operating distance with maximum-Q PICC test antenna.

pcd_field_strength_calibration.purpose: Set PCD transmit power so that field strength at the centre of the operating volume is within [Hmin, Hmax] = [1.5, 7.5] A/m per ISO 14443-2.
pcd_field_strength_calibration.instrument: ISO 10373-6 Calibration Coil Antenna (single-turn 30 mm × 30 mm)
procedure: 1. Place calibration coil at reference position above PCD antenna.
2. Measure induced voltage at the coil; compute field strength H from coil area + frequency.
3. Adjust PCD transmit amplifier output until H is within target window.
4. Verify modulation envelope (100% ASK Type A or 10% ASK Type B) using envelope detector + scope.

pcd_to_picc_timing_calibration.purpose: Ensure PCD modulation pause durations and rise/fall times comply with ISO 14443-2 §8 / §9.
pcd_to_picc_timing_calibration.instrument: RF logic analyser with envelope detector + high-bandwidth scope (≥ 100 MHz)

picc_to_pcd_load_modulation_calibration.purpose: Verify PICC subcarrier amplitude is detectable at the PCD's reference receiver across the operating volume.
procedure: 1. Place a reference PICC (ISO 10373-6 Class 1) at minimum-, mid-, and maximum-coupling positions.
2. Capture envelope at the PCD's RX path with the subcarrier still present.
3. Measure subcarrier amplitude (≥ 22 / sqrt(H_field_strength) mV at reference antenna).
4. Run anti-collision under all three positions; verify successful UID extraction.

carrier_frequency_calibration.purpose: PCD carrier shall be 13.56 MHz ± 517 ppm (≈ ± 7 kHz).
carrier_frequency_calibration.instrument: Frequency counter referenced to GPS-disciplined or OCXO source
procedure: 1. With PCD transmitting unmodulated carrier, count frequency.
2. If outside ± 7 kHz, swap crystal or adjust load capacitance (CL trim caps).

fdt_listen_timing_check.purpose: Verify PICCs respond within fdt_listen ≤ 1172/fc ≈ 86.43 μs at 106 kbps.
procedure: 1. Capture (PCD command EOF) → (PICC response SOF) interval on scope or RF analyser.
3. All conforming PICCs shall meet fdt_listen across the volume.

no_picc_side_trim: The PICC does not expose any calibration register on the air interface — its antenna-resonance trim caps + analog front-end trim are programmed at wafer probe and are permanent. The PCD is the only side that requires field-time calibration.
notes: Conformance per ISO 10373-6 requires the calibrated PCD to be tested against a complete suite of reference PICCs at multiple positions in the operating volume; the AN10833 identification procedure is checked against each ATQA / SAK / GetVersion expected response. Most PCD reader chips (CLRC663 / PN5180 / PN512) expose vendor-specific calibration registers (TxControl, RxThreshold, ModWidth, RFCfg) that are written from the host MCU during the calibration procedure rather than being set in hardware.
